query.text: 请帮我看下老人起身，有危险及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the elderly person getting up, and alert me promptly if there is any danger.

annotation.text_zh: 您站立不稳，请扶好身边的拐杖。
annotation.text_en: You seem a bit unsteady. Please hold onto your cane.

annotation.text_zh: 小心！您正在跌倒，请保护好头部。
annotation.text_en: Watch out! You're falling, protect your head!

annotation.text_zh: 您摔倒了，身体有受伤吗？请先别乱动。
annotation.text_en: You've fallen. Are you hurt? Please don't move just yet.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
